facts.fact: Yna 边煮意面边与 Jaemee 通电话；两人为她的 40 岁生日策划了几周的鸡翅加酒之夜
facts.anchor: They had been planning this night out for weeks—wings and drinks to mark her 40th birthday.

facts.fact: Elizabeth 被托付看家：自称 14 岁不是军训教官，但答应 I'll keep them alive
facts.anchor: I'm fourteen, not a drill sergeant

facts.fact: 出门前换上森林绿毛衣与黑色牛仔裤，放头发化淡妆；Jaemee 短信催 birthday queen
facts.anchor: She pulled on a forest green sweater—simple, cozy, but tailored enough to feel like an actual adult

facts.fact: Jaemee 举杯敬「四十年最 badass 的妈妈兼作家」，愿下一章比上一章更疯
facts.anchor: To forty years of being the most badass mom and author I know.

facts.fact: Marcus 下班后把 Kai 拽进鸡翅店；Kai 低声说不想凑热闹，像个走错邮编的人
facts.anchor: looking like a man who had accidentally stepped into the wrong zip code.

facts.fact: Kai 认出咖啡店的乱发女人；目光像罗盘找北一样飘回卡座，被 Marcus 抓包后自称只是观察
facts.anchor: his eyes pulled back toward the corner booth like a compass seeking north.

facts.fact: 两人同时起身去洗手间在拐角相撞；Yna 尾骨着地、包撒了一地，Kai 晚半拍没接住
facts.anchor: She landed hard on her tailbone with a muffled oomph, her purse slipping from her shoulder

facts.fact: Kai 坐到 Yna 身边，社交三次尝试全失败；她一句 Unstructured is my specialty 接管全场，他从此无法移开目光
facts.anchor: completely unable to take his eyes off her.
